## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Lists the name of each test available to run in an IP or
  system directory: every `task automatic test_<name>` in the testbench
  test files (tb/tests/*_tests.sv, tb_verilog/**/tests/*_tests.sv, ...),
  with the one-line description from the file header's task list, grouped
  by testbench. Used by scripts/run_sim.sh --list-tests (library IP and
  systems), `make list-tests`, and the prompt generators
  (make_ip_prompts.py), so every prompt names the tests.
  A testbench without test_* tasks runs as one test: it is listed under its
  own name with the first sentence of its header description.
```

Per function:

```text
header_descriptions: `//     name  description` entries of the leading comment; a more deeply indented line
continues the entry above it.

tb_summary: First sentence of a testbench's header Description: what the single test checks.

testbench_of: The testbench a test-task file belongs to: tests/<x>_tests.sv -> <x>_tb / tb_<x>.

tests_for: [(testbench, test, description)] for every test file under d (build directories skipped).
```
